name: Equipment Report
query: select ei.name as "Issue:Link/Equipment Issue:140", ei.equipment as "Equipment:Link/Equipment:140", ei.issue_date as "Issue Date:Date:100", ei.expected_return_date as "Due:Date:100", er.return_date as "Returned:Date:100", ei.status as "Status:Data:100", er.damage_charge as "Damage Charge:Currency:110", case when er.name is null and ei.expected_return_date < curdate() and ei.docstatus = 1 then 'Yes' else '' end as "Overdue:Data:80" from `tabEquipment Issue` ei left join `tabEquipment Return` er on er.equipment_issue = ei.name order by ei.issue_date desc
